decisions: Minutes from June 15, 2025 (as amended) were unanimously approved.
Q3 2025 operating budget of $3.35 million approved; Pierre Dubois authorized to renegotiate logistics vendor contracts targeting at least 5% cost reduction by September 30, 2025.

Expansion of Northwind Partners engagement to include supply chain consulting services approved; revised service agreement to be finalized by July 28, 2025; two senior consultants assigned by August 1, 2025; revised revenue projection due July 21, 2025.

Operational technology upgrade approved at estimated cost of $180,000 plus $42,000 annual licensing; Aiyana Park authorized to execute vendor agreement; staff training to be completed by October 15, 2025.
Mid-cycle compensation adjustment of up to 8% for eligible staff approved effective September 1, 2025; formal mentorship program to be launched by Q4 2025.
Professional liability insurance policy renewal approved with current provider at $68,500 annual premium; Pierre Dubois to execute renewal before August 1, 2025.
